claims.text: The Jetson AGX Orin serves the mesh's decision models — Cloudflare Clef 27B (schema-scored decisions, Ampere-fit 4-bit) and, later, a fine-tuned Strands Decider 2B — through lobes, addressable from every mesh member

honesty_conditions.text: Clef answers model=decider on the Orin through the gateway with orin-embed's three lanes still serving, and a 2B decider answers from at least one other box — both shown in an acceptance transcript under docs/evidence/ (#108), not declared.

claims.text: Cloudflare/clef (Apache-2.0, 27.36B bf16, Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B, 48 GDN + 16 full-attn layers, ViT present, mtp_num_hidden_layers=0) is a DECISION model, not a chat model: a joint schema head over the backbone's final hidden states emits one logit per allowed option per question in one forward pass — no free-form generation (huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef card + config.json).

Clef is served through a decision endpoint (the card's documented route is SGLang exposing a Jev/SystemOne-compatible POST /v1/systemone with state + questions), not the OpenAI chat surface; a plain 'vllm serve' never runs the joint head, so lobes needs a new non-chat lane type the gateway can route — nothing under lobes/ or docs/ mentions systemone today.

honesty_conditions.text: The gateway proxies POST /v1/systemone to the decider lane byte-for-byte (no reshaping) and 404s role_infeasible when no decider is hosted or reachable.

claims.text: Clef's 4-bit checkpoint on the Orin (Ampere sm_87) must be WEIGHT-ONLY W4A16 through Marlin: W4A4 NVFP4 needs Blackwell FP4 tensor cores and is ruled out (lobes/machines/orin.py:10-30) and FP8 W8A8 is unsupported on Ampere. Lead candidate JRamirez-UAB/clef-GPTQ-W4A16-g64-embed-int8 (compressed-tensors, ~18 GB, head/ViT/lm_head bf16, vLLM 0.31.0 + a 4-line qwen3_5 embed-quant patch + clef_vllm.py pooling wrapper, 65/68 match vs bf16); second AutomatosX/AX-Clef-27B-CUDA-AXQ-NVFP4-W4A16; avoid kurcontko/simonlehmann clef-NVFP4 (W4A4) and prithivMLmods/clef-FP8.

honesty_conditions.text: The served Clef build's config.json quant_method is weight-only (W4A16/WNA16 or NF4) and vLLM/transformers logs show a Marlin/weight-only kernel, never an FP4-activation path, on sm_87.

claims.text: Strands Decider 2B (StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-qwen3.5-v1-2610, Apache-2.0, AWS Strands Labs) is a rank-16 LoRA plus a ~1M-param fp32 pointer head on Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B-Base with the LM head discarded; no merged weights ship; served by the strands-decider package ('strands-decider serve', POST /v1/systemone) — the same wire Clef speaks; trained/evaluated at a 4096-token window (strands-labs/strands-decider README, HF card).

Strands Decider 2B is served UNQUANTIZED (bf16 torso ~4.5 GiB + fp32 head): no official AWQ/GPTQ/W4A16/FP8 exists, LoRA over a 4-bit base is unvalidated on a GDN hybrid on sm_87 (vllm#29424 tested MoE only), the training recipe and adapters are bf16, and 4.5 GiB is small beside the Orin's ~43 GiB headroom. W4A16 (compressed-tensors/GPTQ) is the fallback only if memory forces it, measured first.

Neither model is the 'hand' role: hand forbids final_decision (lobes/roles.py ROLE_FORBIDDEN, hand ~:537; docs/colleague-stack.md:58 'never decides') and its LoRA serving is vLLM --enable-lora on a generate lane (lobes/templates/fleet/docker-compose.yml:790-880) — a pointer/schema head is not a generate adapter.

honesty_conditions.text: decider's ROLE_FORBIDDEN and hand's stay distinct; no decider checkpoint is routed through vllm-hand's --enable-lora lane.

claims.text: lobes does not train the decider: LoRA/adapter production stays out of tree (docs/colleague-stack.md:322-324 — lobes serves adapters, never trains them); the decider's fine-tune is its own training/recipe.sh run (~11 h on one RTX 3090), whose output lobes only serves.

Clef takes the Orin's single heavy-lobe slot: orin.toml [[exclusive_roles]] (~:117-119) allows one of cortex/senses/associate (orin-cortex/orin-lobe/orin-associate) on 61.3 GiB unified with zero swap, so a Clef-hosting shape joins that exclusive group (and tests/test_init_coresidency.py) and cannot co-reside with the GGUF cortex (~33 GiB) or associate (util 0.70).

honesty_conditions.text: orin.toml exclusive_roles and tests/test_init_coresidency.py are updated so a Clef-hosting shape is refused alongside cortex/senses/associate.

claims.text: Memory fits beside the deployed orin-embed shape: measured resident embedder 5.24 + reranker 5.35 + gemma2-embed 4.69 GiB with 43,531 MiB available (docs/evidence/2026-10-07-accept-orin-embed.txt:86), so W4A16 Clef (~18 GB weights + KV at a decision-sized window) plus a bf16 decider (~4.5 GiB) are expected to fit — DECLARED until measured (#108), with the page-cache and cgroup mem_limit traps of docs/orin-embed-deployment.md:92-114.

This frame does not rewire 'lobes route' (lobes/cli/_commands/route.py asks the hand model for JSON with enable_thinking=false); pointing routing at a decider is a follow-up once a decision lane exists.

Clef serving is staged: start with a transformers sidecar running Cloudflare's own load_release_model (the embed-st sidecar pattern) to MEASURE decision speed on the Orin first; the target path is the faster one — (a) vLLM pooling runner on the W4A16 quant + external joint head, or (b) SGLang dev-clef — chosen once the sidecar baseline exists.

Decision models enter the fleet as a NEW ROLE named 'decider' (accepting that adding a role is effectively irreversible, docs/colleague-stack.md:337-365) — not a hand variant and not a specialist lane.

Adding the 'decider' role touches every per-role surface: ROLES + ROLE_BACKEND/ROLE_ROLE_HINT/ROLE_PATH/ROLE_RESPONSIBILITIES/ROLE_FORBIDDEN/ROLE_MAX_MODEL_LEN_ENV (lobes/roles.py:113-559), COLLEAGUE_ROLES/OPT_IN_CORE_ROLES (lobes/profiles/shapes.py:92,114), schema.py role scope, render.py ROLE_ENV_PREFIX, shape_render.py + cli/_commands/up.py ROLE_SERVICE, gateway/_config.py OPT_IN_BACKENDS/FEASIBLE_ENV/*_BASE_URL, the fleet compose template, every builtin profile + shape TOML, and the ~28-40 golden .env files (tests/goldens/regen.py) — plus a /v1/systemone route the gateway proxies and mesh-forwards (no 'decider' name collides today; only a comment at lobes/roles.py:474 uses the word).

honesty_conditions.text: tests/goldens/regen.py regenerates every golden with a decider line and the full suite passes; docs/colleague-stack.md records the decider role's justification for the irreversible add.

claims.text: 'decider' is an OPT-IN core role (joins OPT_IN_CORE_ROLES like muse/worker/associate): machine-as-brain never hosts a 27B decision model beside cortex+senses, an unwired decider 404s role_infeasible, and only an explicit Orin shape hosts it.

Clef co-resides WITH the deployed orin-embed specialist (embedder + reranker + gemma2-embed stay hosted) if it fits — a Clef-hosting Orin shape adds decider to orin-embed's hosted set rather than replacing it; fit is decided by a live measurement against the ~43.5 GiB available, not by arithmetic.
The Strands decider is retrained on the DGX Sparks (spark / spark2); lobes only serves the resulting LoRA + head.
The jev-factory work (producing decider training data / retraining) runs in a separate session and is not part of this frame; this frame consumes its output only.

honesty_conditions.text: No jev-factory/training code lands in this repo's PRs for this frame.

claims.text: The decider role's contract is the upstream /v1/systemone API as provided: a request carries a state plus typed questions (noul / choice / score) and the answer is the best option PLUS the probability of every allowed option — lobes passes that wire through, it does not reshape it into OpenAI chat.
The Strands Decider 2B may be hosted on ANY lobe box (Spark, spark2, Thor, Orin), for various tasks — it is not pinned to the Orin; Clef 27B is the Orin's decider.

Mesh agents and harnesses (culture agents, Qwen Code, reachy-mini-cli, lobes route) that need a fast, calibrated multiple-choice decision — routing, tool selection, triage, guardrails — instead of parsing a chat model's prose; and the operator deploying it.

honesty_conditions.text: At least one named consumer (lobes route or a culture agent) has a concrete decision it would send to /v1/systemone instead of a chat completion.

claims.text: Today the fleet has no decision model: every typed decision is a chat completion whose answer must be parsed out of prose (lobes route asks the hand model for JSON, lobes/cli/_commands/route.py), with no per-option probabilities, and no lobes surface knows /v1/systemone.

honesty_conditions.text: grep finds no systemone/decider surface in lobes/ on main at the time of writing (verified 2026-10-14 in the scope pass).

claims.text: A schema-scored decision returns calibrated probabilities over a closed option set in one forward pass — no generation, no output parsing, no hallucinated option — so callers can threshold on confidence and escalate to cortex only when the decider is unsure.

honesty_conditions.text: The per-option probabilities the decider returns are usable for thresholding — the strands/clef cards' calibration claims hold on our own probe set, or the caveat is recorded.

claims.text: Any mesh member answers model=decider on POST /v1/systemone: the Orin serves Clef 27B (4-bit, co-resident with orin-embed) and any box may host a Strands Decider 2B; GET /capabilities advertises the decider role with its checkpoint, quant and feasibility, and a box that hosts none forwards to a verified member.

honesty_conditions.text: Every surface named (model=decider, /v1/systemone, /capabilities advert, mesh forwarding) exists and is exercised by a test or an evidence transcript.

claims.text: On the Orin, with orin-embed still serving: Clef answers a /v1/systemone choice question through the gateway with probabilities summing to 1 (±0.01) per question, top-1 matching the bf16 reference on >= 90% of a fixed probe set, and the minimum available host memory stays >= 2 GiB (orin-embed decision c25 floor); median decision latency for a <= 4096-token state is recorded (sidecar baseline, then the faster path).

honesty_conditions.text: The probe set, the bf16 reference answers and the latency numbers are all filed in a docs/evidence/ transcript; the bf16 reference is computed off-box (Spark) since bf16 Clef cannot load on the Orin.

honesty_conditions.text: The 2B is booted on a box other than the Orin and reached cross-box via the mesh, transcripted.

claims.text: decider responsibilities: typed_decision, classification, routing_choice, triage, guardrail_check; forbidden: final_decision, repo_action, security_decision — it scores options, cortex/agents act on them (mirrors the q5 decision: answer + probabilities, not authority).

honesty_conditions.text: lobes/roles.py ROLE_RESPONSIBILITIES/ROLE_FORBIDDEN for decider match this text and tests/test_colleague_contract.py pins it.

claims.text: Decider addressing is model=decider:<domain> — one FLAT, mesh-wide namespace of domains (not per-box member lanes): a caller names the domain, never the box, and whichever member hosts that domain answers.
A box hosts zero, one or more Strands Decider 2B checkpoints (one per domain); none is required anywhere.
The decider role MAY carry final_decision (c27's 'forbidden: final_decision' is rejected).
The target serving engine for the faster stage is vLLM 0.31 (the version the JRamirez W4A16 quant was validated on) — preferred, to be validated on the Orin; expected to work.
Loading a 4-bit Clef together with its joint head under transformers on the Orin is confirmed as the first spike (the sidecar stage's go/no-go).

decider role contract: responsibilities typed_decision, classification, routing_choice, triage, guardrail_check, final_decision; forbidden repo_action, security_decision — it decides over a closed option set and returns the best answer + all probabilities, but never acts on the repo or rules on security.

honesty_conditions.text: lobes/roles.py ROLE_RESPONSIBILITIES/ROLE_FORBIDDEN for decider match this text and tests/test_colleague_contract.py pins it.

claims.text: Domain routing: each decider:<domain> is advertised in GET /capabilities with its checkpoint and quant and mesh-forwarded by name (like a specialist lane, docs/colleague-stack.md#specialist-lanes-not-roles); a domain name must be mesh-unique — two members announcing the same domain with different fingerprints is a refused conflict, never a silent pick; an unknown domain 404s model_not_found (mirrors hand:<domain>).

honesty_conditions.text: A test registers two members announcing the same domain with different fingerprints and asserts the conflict is refused; a cross-box decider:<domain> forward is shown in an evidence transcript.

claims.text: Clef is the general-purpose domain: plain model=decider (no domain) resolves to decider:general, served by Clef 27B on the Orin.
